name: OpenOS 1.7.0
description: Apps can carry an icon on their Home tile (#appIcon), the accent colour is yours to pick in Settings > Display, and a swipe up from the bottom edge of Home opens an alphabetical app drawer with search. Control Center keeps the last eight notifications; the lock screen can show the weather for a place chosen under Time & Date. For app authors: #const header constants, ui.toast with a duration, theme.accent(), and scripts of up to 1024 lines. Update Home, Control Center, Settings and the lock screen from OpenStore after installing.
